svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Global primary plastic production by polymer 1990 to 2019
Polymers are color-coded to indicate recyclability: green for widely recycled, blue for moderately recycled,
orange for limited recyclability, red for usually non-recycled, and violet for unknown recyclability.
